text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What is this garbage code? There's
unnecessary
repetition all over the
place.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, why reuse variables like this?
There's no
naming conventions or
anything—it's a total mess.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Agh! Damn it all to hell! How deep do
you plan to
make me dig?! I'm not a
damn archaeologist!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur is stressing out over
someone's poorly
written spaghetti
code.
